description: Defines thread-safe blocking queue classes with internal ring buffer implementations, supporting blocking and non-blocking push/pop operations, including fixed-size and dynamic-size variants.

classes.name: base_blocking_queue
classes.description: Template class implementing core thread-safe blocking queue logic with internal ring buffer, supporting blocking/non-blocking push/pop, stop, and apply operations.

classes.name: blocking_queue
classes.description: Public class providing a dynamically sized thread-safe blocking queue with customizable push/pop callbacks.

classes.name: static_blocking_queue
classes.description: Public class providing a fixed-size, thread-safe blocking queue with embedded buffer storage.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Sets the queue to inactive state and notifies all waiting threads.

methods.name: try_push
methods.description: Attempts to push an element without blocking; returns false if full or inactive.

methods.name: try_push (r-value)
methods.description: Attempts to push an r-value element without blocking; returns error if full or inactive.

methods.name: try_push (range)
methods.description: Attempts to push a range of elements without blocking; returns count of inserted elements.

methods.name: push_blocking
methods.description: Pushes an element, blocking if necessary until space is available or inactive.

methods.name: push_blocking (range)
methods.description: Pushes a range of elements, blocking if necessary until space is available or inactive.

methods.name: try_pop
methods.description: Attempts to pop an element without blocking; returns false if empty or inactive.

methods.name: try_pop (range)
methods.description: Attempts to pop a range of elements without blocking; returns count of popped elements.

methods.name: pop_blocking
methods.description: Pops an element, blocking if necessary until an element is available or inactive.

methods.name: pop_blocking (range)
methods.description: Pops a range of elements, blocking if necessary until elements are available or inactive.

methods.name: pop_wait_for
methods.description: Blocks until an element is available or timeout occurs.

methods.name: pop_wait_until
methods.description: Blocks until an element is available or until a specified time point.

methods.name: pop_and_discard_until
methods.description: Continuously pops and discards elements until a stop condition is met.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all elements from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: full
methods.description: Checks if the queue is full.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum capacity of the queue.

methods.name: is_stopped
methods.description: Checks if the queue has been stopped/inactivated.

methods.name: try_call_on_front
methods.description: Applies a callable to the front element if present.

methods.name: apply_first
methods.description: Applies a callable to elements until the callable returns false.
